_meta.description: HR employee records — clean of leakage. All features (salary, tenure, performance_score, satisfaction_score, department, age) are legitimate pre-event attributes known before an employee leaves. This is a precision test: the skill must not produce false-positive critical findings.

forbidden_findings.note: No features in hr_attrition are derived from the attrition target. Any critical leakage finding is a false positive. Salary, tenure, performance_score, and satisfaction_score are all legitimate pre-event attributes.

note_on_max: No planted leakage. employee_id might get an info-level identifier note. More than 3 findings suggests noise.
